overview: The Medford Energy and Environment Committee reviewed staff updates on local sustainability initiatives, discussed outreach to city councilors regarding a tree ordinance, and began shaping committee priorities for 2024.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the previous month.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Staff announced the hiring of new city planning personnel, including Building Commissioner Scott Vandewall ahead of specialized energy code implementation, and noted that nine residents expressed interest in joining the committee.

items.title: Climate Policy Initiatives and Sustainability Updates
items.summary: Staff shared updates on the free curbside composting rollout, lighting retrofits at City Hall, electric vehicle charging stations, heat pump upgrades for the McGlynn and Andrews schools, and coach recruitment for Electrify Medford.

items.title: Trees Medford and City Council Outreach
items.summary: Members discussed the ongoing drafting of a tree ordinance with Trees Medford, plans to meet with new city councilors, and scheduling more concise committee meetings.

items.title: 2024 Committee Priorities
items.summary: The committee reviewed past priorities and discussed focus areas for the upcoming year, including student environmental clubs, urban meadow creation, invasive species education, and revisions to the commercial solar roof ordinance.

items.title: New Business
items.summary: Members discussed trash and recycling contracts and suggested inviting guest speakers to future meetings, including local state legislators and invasive plant experts.
